name: Home
description: EXP-011 §79 fixture: two Sign In With nodes on a project whose backend is at http://localhost:8591. `acme` (Provider acme, Redirect blank: come back here) is pressed by the Sign in with Acme button; its Signing In, Error and Notice each show in a Text, and Done / Failure write a `last` Variable through String-fed Set Variables. `nobody` has no Provider — the refusal — pressed by its own button; its Error shows, and its Completed writes a `refused` Variable. A User node shows who is signed in, which is how the return leg's session is seen.
